source_brief.scene: An arena-like semicircle of oversized cyan, pink and warm-white DOMINO outline props around an open central stage, each bay contains finite supported upright and leaning alternate contour frames. Hero one bright leaning domino next to upright bright neighbors; inactive alternatives dim. Four bottom storyboard cells show upright row, first leaning, two neighbors responding, wave progressing around curve. No actually falling props, no strobe effect.
